RenderedContentElement.title: Rendered content element
RenderedContentElement.description: A single node of the RENDERED model, as the preview response body carries it. This is the counterpart of `StoredContentElement` on the far side of the storage/render split: it carries `id`, `component`, a flat `properties` map, its `slots` and its `style`, and nothing else — no data requirements, no context wiring and no binding attribution, because those authoring concerns have finished their work before anything renders. It is response-only and is never accepted on input; a preview REQUEST body carries `StoredContentElement` nodes. Key order on the wire is `id`, `component`, `properties`, `slots`, `style`, with `apiAlias` last at every depth.

id.description: Element identifier, carried through from the stored element the node was rendered from. Unique across every root of the rendered page.

component.description: The registered element type this node is an instance of. Registry-driven, so the valid values are intentionally not enumerated here; fetch the live list from `GET /api/_info/content-system-element-types.json` (the `name` of each entry). No length or format bound is stated: the rendered model applies no validation of its own, and a render-time listener may mint a node directly, so only the stored tree this was rendered from was checked for non-emptiness.

properties.description: The rendered property values keyed by property name, always present. Unlike the stored map, this one draws no distinction between a statically authored value, a value a data loader produced and a value delivered by context — they are merged into one flat map. Values are therefore not restricted to scalars and containers: a hydrated entity payload appears here as its encoded object. An empty map is serialized as `[]` (consistent with Shopware's JSON-map fields).

slots.description: Child element subtrees keyed by slot name, each slot holding an ordered list of rendered child elements. Omitted entirely when the element has no slots — never serialized as an empty container.

style.description: Universal presentation options keyed by option wire name (for example `col-span`, `align-self`), carried through unchanged from the stored element. Each value is either a single scalar (a flat option) or an object keyed by breakpoint (`xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `xxl`) for a breakpoint-aware option, per the option's `breakpointAware` flag in the style-option introspection schema. Omitted when the element has no style.

apiAlias.description: The API alias identifying this object as a rendered content element. Present on every node at every depth, and written last.
